confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of local pricing; no live menus, listings or booking pages were checked. Café and restaurant anchors are moderately reliable, while July accommodation is least certain because festival-season demand can move rates sharply. Cocktail and wine anchors were set partly from their local relationship to the beer anchor, since direct knowledge is thinner. The FX value comes from RBA pages surfaced in search results; the RBA data file itself was not opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of comparable mid-sized Provence tourist cities such as Avignon and Arles, with upward adjustment for higher café and hotel pricing and July peak-season demand; no price data was looked up for these comparisons.
